Source contracts: src/agent_runtime/recipes

src/agent_runtime/recipes/init.py

Python · Tier A

Native recipes and persistence.

src/agent_runtime/recipes/bindings.py

Python · Tier A

Interpret the closed JSON binding language used by recorded workflows. expression/expressions recognize exact parameter and prior-step references; render deep-copies literals and resolves fresh structured results, rejecting missing parameters and ambiguous array selection. leaves and replace support reviewed parameter edits by JSON pointer. Strings remain data, and this module performs no code evaluation, tool dispatch or authority changes.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
expression 21 Recognize only exact typed parameter or prior-step JSON expression shapes. Ordinary values return None; any other dollar-prefixed mapping raises workflow_invalid instead of being evaluated.
valid_pointer 42 Accept an empty root pointer or a slash-prefixed JSON pointer of at most 1024 characters with valid tilde escapes; this checks syntax without resolving data.
expressions 52 Walk nested dictionaries/lists and yield typed bindings as indivisible expressions, propagating invalid dollar-expression errors.
render 67 Deep-copy literal data, substitute supplied parameters and resolve prior-step pointers only from provided fresh results. Leave step expressions deferred when results are absent; reject missing inputs and ambiguous array selections instead of choosing among multiple matches.
leaves 101 Yield escaped JSON-pointer paths and scalar values while skipping typed expressions, allowing capture and parameter suggestions to inspect literal fields safely.
replace 116 Mutate one existing non-root dictionary/list field with a deep copy of the replacement. Reject invalid paths; this helper performs no string interpolation or object attribute access.

src/agent_runtime/recipes/errors.py

Python · Tier A

Give recipe validation, capture and runtime constraints stable catalog-owned errors. RecipeError selects a bounded public description and emits a nonexecuted error receipt; ParameterBindingCaptureError explains why resolved parameter values cannot be captured as reusable literals. Rejected payloads are not interpolated into these diagnostics. Callers choose HTTP/native projection and recovery behavior.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
RecipeError 14 Represent a workflow failure by its catalog-owned recipe identity and public description, without embedding rejected arguments or secret-bearing payloads.
RecipeError.receipt 22 Return a complete nonexecuted error receipt with the catalog identity and description for normal native/HTTP failure projection.
ParameterBindingCaptureError 33 Reject capture before any bound parameter can become a reusable literal.

src/agent_runtime/recipes/memory_store.py

Python · Tier A

Store recipe definitions, immutable execution revisions and run claims on the Controller RAM authority. RecipeRecords maintains ordered indexes; MemoryRecipeStore publishes validated edits, overlap checks and first-settlement counters atomically. Recorded-workflow retention preserves uncertain effects; saved requests have separate idempotency/open-run rules. Recovery tables seed the repository and shared checkpoints save it, while runtime access never falls back to SQL or dispatches tasks.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
initialize 36 Initialize supported recovery tables and stable recipe/run insertion ordinals before importing the live RAM repository.
schemas 49 Describe recipe definitions, immutable revisions, run history and order metadata for recovery import/checkpoint encoding, including JSON columns and lookup indexes.
RecipeRecords 69 Maintain recipe status and per-recipe run ordering as part of the enclosing RAM transaction.
RecipeRecords.changed 72 Assign stable insertion order and update sorted definition/history indexes when records change; all index mutations share their publication transaction.
record 102 Thaw a stored row into a detached validated recipe/run model, translating JSON-suffixed columns; return None for an absent row.
encoded 112 Copy model fields into the exact recovery-schema columns so mutable caller values do not alias RAM authority.
unresolved 119 Detect recorded steps still running or outcome_unknown in run metadata so admission and retention preserve uncertain effects.
MemoryRecipeStore 128 Own live recipe definitions, pinned revisions and run claims through atomic RAM publications. Checkpoint infrastructure owns disk recovery; runtime methods do not fall back to SQLite.
MemoryRecipeStore.get_recipe 169 Return a detached current definition, optionally excluding archived records.
MemoryRecipeStore.get_revision 179 Read the immutable snapshot for an exact recipe/revision pair, returning None when no pin exists.
MemoryRecipeStore.list_revisions 185 Return at most 100 revision numbers and creation timestamps in descending revision order; this is a bounded index view, not every retained definition.
MemoryRecipeStore.create_recipe 194 Validate the artifact, assign identity/timestamps, clip display/source fields and publish the current definition with its initial immutable revision atomically.
MemoryRecipeStore.list_recipes 223 Read a newest-first indexed page, filtering active/archive visibility and title/description/prompt search. Preserve SQLite-style percent/underscore wildcards and ASCII case folding while limiting results to 500.
MemoryRecipeStore.update_recipe 257 Validate the observed revision and definition edits inside one transaction. Increment the execution revision only when its hash changes, retain prior pins and publish the updated current record.
MemoryRecipeStore.archive_recipe 275 Hide the current definition through the shared update path while retaining revision snapshots and run history.
MemoryRecipeStore.create_run 281 Pin an existing definition revision and atomically claim a run. Saved requests reuse an identical run ID/revision and reject any other open run; recorded workflows validate parameters and reject pending/running or unresolved predecessors. No task is dispatched here.
MemoryRecipeStore.get_run 345 Return a detached run record for the exact identity or None when absent or pruned.
MemoryRecipeStore.list_runs 353 Read up to 200 newest run records for one recipe using update/create order and stable insertion ties.
MemoryRecipeStore.update_run 365 Atomically merge runtime history, apply privacy checks and stamp settlement. Increment the definition's count only on its first settlement and retain at most 200 settled recorded- workflow runs, preserving unresolved steps; saved-request history is not pruned by this rule.
repository 429 Reuse the hub's recipe repository or register one for the requested recovery path; reject attempts to bind the same domain to another path.

src/agent_runtime/recipes/models.py

Python · Tier A

Define recipe definition, parameter, revision and run-history data shared by RAM/standalone stores and adapters. The models retain native_intent, recorded_workflow_v1 and saved_request_v1 kinds, while current HTTP routes accept saved requests through narrower payloads. Execution hashes and semantic constraints are computed by validation/store layers; these Pydantic contracts themselves neither authorize nor execute work.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
RecipeParameter 36 Describe a typed editable field, its default and optional reference-only constraint; recorded- workflow validation separately enforces names, bounds and credential-reference use.
AgentRecipeCreate 56 Carry the definition and source provenance for one of three retained artifact kinds. Validation recomputes derived hashes/capabilities rather than trusting supplied metadata.
AgentRecipeUpdate 81 Represent partial definition edits and an optional store-level revision precondition; current HTTP editing uses a narrower saved-request contract with a required revision.
AgentRecipeRecord 98 Represent the current saved definition, execution revision and usage timestamps; immutable accepted revisions are stored separately.
AgentRecipeRunWrite 130 Describe a run claim or history write with optional exact run ID and pinned revision. Store rules determine idempotency and overlap behavior by artifact kind.
AgentRecipeRunRecord 147 Retain the pinned revision/hash, request identity, outcome and metadata for one invocation; a history row does not itself launch work.
RecipeCaptureCandidate 168 Report capture eligibility, bounded errors, optional proposed definition and parameter suggestions without persisting or executing the proposal.

src/agent_runtime/recipes/native.py

Python · Tier A

Support retained native-intent recipes separately from current saved-request HTTP workflows. capture builds a reusable goal/obligation contract from accepted completion; invocation validates typed parameters, requires fresh evidence and intersects capability ceilings. execute_recipe enters the ordinary model-led runtime; explicit resume context retains its identities. This compatibility path does not replay old receipts or automatically convert other artifact kinds.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
NativeRecipeContract 22 Retain the older native-intent goal, instructions, obligations, requirements and optional capability ceiling; this is distinct from the current saved-request HTTP contract.
invocation 34 Validate native-intent parameters and fresh-evidence requirements, merge defaults with supplied values and construct a new prompt/context. Intersect capability ceilings when both exist and remove old run/conversation identities unless explicitly resuming.
capture 106 Create an older native-intent candidate when completion_accepted is truthy. This helper does not independently recheck terminal status or receipt topology. Retain the goal and reusable obligations/requirements, excluding operation-bound requirements; no model or tool runs here.
execute_recipe 138 Invoke the normal runtime for native intent using the caller's request ID and saved/default parameter values. The compatibility prompt argument is unused: the saved contract supplies the goal. Invocation clears earlier native identities unless native_resume_required explicitly keeps them; other artifact kinds are rejected and source receipts are never replayed.

src/agent_runtime/recipes/privacy.py

Python · Tier A

Prevent known credential material from entering reusable recorded-workflow definitions and history. check traverses JSON using the canonical database redaction classifier, rejecting detected secrets instead of silently modifying values; source_secrets collects owned provenance and reference validates bounded @name syntax. Typed expressions defer value checks to admission. This boundary does not rewrite ordinary execution arguments or guarantee detection inside arbitrary binary attachments.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
check 33 Traverse retained JSON and reject detected credentials or redaction markers rather than silently replacing them. Typed expressions are deferred; secret-named fields require parameter expressions, whose reference-only values are checked at admission. Detection uses the canonical classifier and supplied known secrets, not exhaustive binary inspection.
source_secrets 62 Gather known credential scalars from the owned run context, sensitive parameter snapshots and receipt arguments/data so capture can reject those values even outside familiar secret fields.
reference 79 Recognize the bounded @name reference syntax used by reference-only workflow parameters; existence and current authorization are checked elsewhere.

src/agent_runtime/recipes/recorded_workflow.py

Python · Tier A

Define the retained recorded-workflow graph and its execution identity. RecordedWorkflow validates ordered dependencies, typed result references, manual/optional constraints and size limits; WorkflowStep stores reviewed tool contracts and effects. execution_hash identifies execution-affecting revisions, while risk_summary derives structural counts and unattended eligibility. These schemas neither replay receipts nor grant current tool permission; validation/runtime modules enforce invocation requirements.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
Condition 25 Describe a named fresh-resolution, successful-receipt or result-present condition and its optional JSON pointer; the runtime decides how supported conditions constrain execution.
TargetPolicy 33 Declare invocation-selected or fixed-Gateway intent for a recorded workflow without storing a live connection or granting access.
TargetPolicy.exact 41 Require a Gateway identity exactly when target mode is fixed; reject an identity attached to invocation-selected mode or a missing fixed identity.
WorkflowStep 49 Describe one tool, manual or checkpoint step with reviewed arguments, dependencies, result bindings and effect constraints. This schema is saved data; it does not dispatch tools.
RecordedWorkflow 76 Bound the recorded graph to 64 steps/parameters and a versioned agent-guided contract whose invocations require fresh evidence and normal permissions.
RecordedWorkflow.graph 94 Require unique ordered steps, backward-only dependencies, valid declared result pointers and consistent manual/optional rules. Validate prior-step bindings against dependencies and declared outputs, then reject serialized artifacts over 128 KiB.
execution_hash 135 Hash execution-affecting artifact, defaults, parameter schema and contract version. Display title/description and run counters are excluded, so renaming alone does not create an execution revision.
risk_summary 152 Derive effects, write/manual counts and structural unattended eligibility from the graph; current authorization is still checked separately on each invocation.

src/agent_runtime/recipes/recorder.py

Python · Tier A

Extract retained recorded-workflow candidates from accepted native completion and owned durable receipts. extract verifies dependency topology, current tool contracts and fresh structured result bindings; capture returns bounded eligibility errors, and suggestions proposes typed parameter edits without applying them. Unknown effects, unprovable/ambiguous producers, resolved parameter bindings and detected secrets block capture. No model is called, no receipt is replayed and interactive desktop action recording remains explicitly unavailable.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
declared_pointer 41 Require a result pointer to traverse declared structured schema fields and exclude free-form output/prose fields. This is structural eligibility for a binding, not proof that a result exists.
suggestions 61 Group repeated scalar literals and resource-like fields into up to 64 deterministic parameter suggestions with unique names and exact edit locations. Suggestions do not modify the workflow until reviewed edits are applied.
extract 106 Build a bounded recorded-workflow candidate from accepted completion and owned successful receipts. Reject unknown effects, bound parameter values, ambiguous resource producers, missing dependencies and historical identities; preserve selected writes/order and replace verified result dependencies with typed step bindings. Perform privacy and current registry validation without inference or replay.
leaves_without_sources 365 Walk literal scalar fields with escaped pointers while treating temporary source-binding mappings as indivisible during dependency extraction.
capture 383 Read owned ordered receipts and translate expected extraction/shape failures into a non-saveable candidate with a bounded reason. The recorder never invokes a model to repair an unprovable graph.
recording_support 396 Report that interactive action recording is unavailable on all listed platforms because adapters expose no scoped user-action subscription; no keystroke, clipboard or screen recorder is started.

src/agent_runtime/recipes/runtime.py

Python · Tier A

Constrain retained recorded-workflow execution inside the normal native Agent loop. invocation revalidates current contracts/scope; guard persists step ownership before effects, observe records fresh receipt outcomes, and control_guard prevents alternate execution surfaces or premature completion. Human checkpoints use the existing input boundary; adapter-owned reconciliation can establish an applied uncertain effect without retrying it. History stores step/receipt references while output bodies remain in the owned result store. This module dispatches no tools itself.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
invocation 29 Revalidate a recorded workflow, substitute parameter data and construct fresh execution context with its pinned definition/hash. Remove old run, conversation and parameter-binding identities; include reviewed plan text only when Task Context is unavailable.
initialize 72 Seed durable step states once and require the saved workflow definition to match exactly on resume. A changed definition fails with revision_mismatch rather than resetting completed/uncertain steps.
projection 92 Return a detached step-state summary and pinned revision with reconciliation guidance for the ordinary Agent loop; this projection does not advance execution.
control_guard 121 Block successful finish while required steps remain incomplete and reject alternate child/parallel execution surfaces that could escape the recorded mutation constraints. Return an ordinary error receipt when blocked.
guard 153 Allow reconciliation reads but reject further effects after uncertain/running or failed steps. Match pending tool steps by completed dependencies, current contract, exact rendered arguments and effect, ignoring refresh/timeout hints and normalizing the transform input default; save running state before dispatch so a crash cannot make the mutation appear unattempted.
observe 235 Project the matched fresh receipt into completed, pending-approval, failed or outcome-unknown step state. Verify result-present postconditions, retain only receipt references and save/synchronize history; uncertain effects require reconciliation before further writes.
sync_history 283 Copy step states and current native run identity into the linked recipe-run record when the context identifies its store and run. Output bodies remain in the normal result store.
catalog_for 304 Construct the ordinary native tool catalog with execution configuration and injected services so workflow revalidation uses current adapter prerequisites and capability ceilings.
checkpoint_requested 329 Bind an exact manual/checkpoint instruction to the existing Ask User operation once its dependencies are complete; this only updates step state and relies on the caller's checkpoint persistence.
checkpoint_answered 351 Mark the matching waiting-user step complete only after the normal human-input boundary accepts its pending operation; retain confirmation state without copying the answer into recipe metadata.
reconcile 364 Accept only an adapter-owned applied-outcome assertion attached to a fresh successful owned read. Verify equivalent result pointers, preserve the original uncertain receipt, clear its unresolved marker and save the new evidence; absence or model prose never authorizes a repeated write.

src/agent_runtime/recipes/saved_request.py

Python · Tier A

Capture current Workflows as exact prompts, saved execution intent and independently owned optional context. SavedRequest/snapshot_settings remove transient and model-routing authority; Assets writes/verifies digest-addressed files, capture_context enforces the original request boundary and materialize creates historical attachment references for each new conversation. default_settings resolves accepted operator policy without inference. Saving is independent of task launch and does not make old results current evidence; new accepted runs capture current model configuration.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
execution_status 34 Map native answers/waits into recipe history states while preserving paused, partial and interrupted outcomes; unknown statuses pass through rather than becoming success.
Inclusion 49 Keep prior chat, attached inputs and previous tool results independently opt-in when saving a request.
Asset 58 Describe one copied context asset by category, SHA-256, name, media type, byte length (at most 64 MiB) and logical record count.
SavedRequest 70 Persist an exact prompt, normalized saved execution intent and up to 16 optional owned context assets. This versioned contract contains no recorded execution steps or past approvals.
SavedRequest.valid 82 Reject blank prompts, assets outside enabled categories and missing saved Gateway intent. Normalize settings through snapshot_settings before accepting the definition.
snapshot_settings 109 Copy supported execution intent, reject malformed working directories/credential-bearing endpoints and apply privacy checks. Remove source conversation/transport/recipe identities and all model-routing, generation/output configuration fields; each accepted run captures current model authority separately.
Assets 197 Content-addressed copies live beside recipes, never under conversation GC.
Assets.put 208 Limit content to 64 MiB, write a private temporary file, fsync and atomically replace its digest path when absent, then verify the stored bytes. Existing digest files are verified rather than overwritten; definition storage remains a separate operation.
Assets.read 243 Validate asset metadata and require both byte length and SHA-256 to match the owned file; translate missing or corrupt content into a workflow-unavailable error.
source_request 266 Recover the exact prompt and accepted execution context from available turn, task, native, trace and live state without requiring success. Resolve the conversation through RAM or standalone turn storage when necessary; fail when no owned source remains.
capture_context 322 Copy or preview only the accepted branch before the selected request. Keep chat, inputs and timestamped prior tool results separate; reject missing boundaries, enabled missing assets, detected text secrets, integrity failures or a raced source deletion. Copies may exist before final definition commit; binary inputs are not exhaustively scanned for credentials.
materialize 535 Verify each owned asset and create independent attachment references for a new conversation. Label copied chat/results as historical evidence, preserving input bytes without granting past receipts or approvals authority.
default_settings 565 Resolve current composer/default controls, accepted permission/capability/runtime policies and selected Gateway without inference. Reject public model overrides and pass the resulting intent through snapshot_settings; it does not create a task.

src/agent_runtime/recipes/scheduling.py

Python · Tier A

Bind reviewed recipe identity, revision and parameter data to the ordinary Schedule Skill event store. create_recipe_schedule rejects unattended recorded workflows containing manual steps, filters accepted timing fields and calls shared schedule creation. scope validates the recipe-specific subset when future-task context is captured. Neither helper runs tasks or creates a second scheduler; current saved-request HTTP scheduling also uses the shared event service.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
create_recipe_schedule 19 Create an ordinary Agent schedule carrying the recipe identity, pinned revision and checked parameter values. Recorded workflows with manual/checkpoint steps cannot run unattended; only supported timing/notification fields reach shared schedule creation.
scope 56 Retain only a validated scheduled recipe identity, positive revision and privacy-checked parameter values from future-task context; return empty for unrelated schedules.

src/agent_runtime/recipes/store.py

Python · Tier A

Select a hub-owned RAM recipe repository or provide standalone SQLite definition/revision/history storage. AgentRecipeStore validates definitions, pins execution revisions, serializes run claims and retains compatibility artifact kinds; shared apply_recipe_update protects recorded graph constraints. Schema version 3 supports additive version-2 migration. Standalone settlement and retention have documented differences from RAM; task admission, model work and copied context files belong to other owners.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
utc_now_iso 38 Create UTC ISO timestamps for recipe definitions, revisions and run history.
AgentRecipeStore 69 Persist saved recipes and their lightweight execution history.
AgentRecipeStore.get_revision 120 Decode the exact pinned definition revision or return None if unavailable.
AgentRecipeStore.list_revisions 131 Expose up to 100 newest revision identities/timestamps without loading every definition payload.
AgentRecipeStore.create_recipe 168 Validate and insert a current recipe with its initial immutable revision in one transaction; clip display/source fields and return the stored definition.
AgentRecipeStore.get_recipe 218 Read the current definition by normalized identity, optionally excluding archived records; empty/unknown IDs return None.
AgentRecipeStore.list_recipes 234 Return up to 500 newest definitions with optional archive visibility and SQL LIKE search over title, description and source prompt.
AgentRecipeStore.update_recipe 266 Use an immediate transaction to validate edits and optional expected revision, preserve snapshots and increment the execution revision only when its hash changes.
AgentRecipeStore.archive_recipe 306 Mark the current definition archived while retaining revisions and execution history.
AgentRecipeStore.create_run 312 Resolve a pinned revision, validate recorded parameters and serialize overlap checks with insertion in an immediate transaction. Saved-request retries reuse an exact run ID/revision; unresolved recorded effects prevent new claims. Task creation is a separate owner/effect.
AgentRecipeStore.update_run 401 Merge status/request/error/metadata and stamp terminal history using the current row snapshot. Sequential first settlement increments the recipe count; recorded cleanup retains 200 completed/failed/cancelled rows and preserves uncertain step states. The initial row read occurs before the write lock, unlike the RAM transaction's atomic settlement check.
AgentRecipeStore.get_run 486 Read and validate an exact standalone run identity, returning None for an empty or absent ID.
AgentRecipeStore.list_runs 499 Return up to 200 newest run-history rows for one recipe, or an empty list for an empty identity.
initialize_recipe_schema 519 Create version-3 definitions, runs and immutable revision storage; migrate supported version-2 columns additively and backfill current definition pins. Unsupported pre-baseline formats are rejected rather than silently rewritten.
apply_recipe_update 621 Validate an optional revision precondition, merge metadata and normalize the new artifact. Recorded edits cannot remove required steps/dependencies, change existing tool identity/effect/contracts or introduce new tool steps; return the updated model without writing storage.

src/agent_runtime/recipes/validation.py

Python · Tier A

Validate recipe definitions and recorded-workflow invocations without inference or execution. validate dispatches by artifact kind and recomputes hashes/derived metadata; parameters merges typed defaults and supplied data with size/privacy/reference checks; historical rejects stale transient identities. revalidate binds recorded workflows to current catalog contracts, Gateway intent, availability and parameter references before runtime constraints apply. Optional registry validation at save time does not replace admission checks.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
historical 57 Reject transient operation/binding identities recursively and require ephemeral resource fields to use deferred prior-step references. This prevents saved arguments from treating stale handles as fresh evidence.
parameters 74 Merge schema defaults, recipe defaults and supplied values, then enforce names, types, finite numeric scalars, required/reference-only fields and permitted JSON-schema constraints. Cap encoded values at 64 KiB and apply privacy checks; require=False permits missing required values while saving a definition.
validate 123 Normalize each supported artifact kind and compute its execution hash. Saved requests discard legacy parameter/capability/risk fields; recorded workflows derive capabilities/references and, when a registry is supplied, verify tool hashes, result pointers, effects and resolvable literal arguments. This validation never executes work.
revalidate 227 At recorded-workflow invocation, validate the graph against the live catalog, resolve parameters and check revision, fixed Gateway, unattended eligibility, capability availability and required parameter references. Return the normalized recipe, workflow and values or a typed error.
